Eve: Quick follow-up from today: we need a very small, stable decision_trace payload that callers can log in production without exploding header sizes.
Marco: agreed. current `decision_trace` is too chatty. propose a compact `decision_summary` with fixed fields and an optional `trace_id` pointing at the full trace in backend.
Anya: what fields are required in the compact version?
Marco: minimal set: winner_source (client_pin|rollout|manifest), winner_id (model id or variant id), reason_code (enum), precedence (int), pin_epoch (int|null), trace_id (uuid|null). All short strings/ints. Example: winner_source=client_pin;winner_id=m-v2;reason=hard_pin;precedence=100;pin_epoch=42;trace_id=8a3f
Eve: good. Also need a stable set of reason_codes so tooling can alert automatically. Suggested codes: hard_pin, soft_pin, rollout_weight, fallback_no_model, fallback_incompatible, manifest_revoked.
Anya: include `compat_tags_hit` as a small bitmask string? That could encode compatibility checks (kv,quant,cache-format). But keep it optional to avoid header bloat.
Marco: agree optional. For headers we only send the compact summary; full decision object stored in trace store accessible via trace_id (retention policy 30d).
Eve: how does this interact with offline manifests and deltas?
Marco: manifest applier should populate winner_source=manifest and winner_id=manifest_id; reason_code="manifest_valid" or "manifest_expired". If manifest caused fallback, reason_code=fallback_incompatible. trace_id maps to manifest provenance.
Anya: we need a compatibility contract on model metadata so `fallback_hint` can be deterministic. Define small compatibility tags: kv_safe, kv_compat_v2, quant_8, quant_4, streaming_ok. Resolver picks fallback whose tags are a superset of requested tags and with minimal distance metric.
Eve: define distance as number of mismatched tags; ties broken by precedence then model age. Documented and tested.
Marco: telemetry changes: emit `resolver.decision_summary` metric (counter) with labels winner_source,reason_code,tenant,route. Also histogram resolver.decision_latency_ms. For trace sampling, default 1% but always store full trace when reason_code starts with fallback_.
Anya: ops note: make header key `X-RW-Decision` and keep value <= 256 chars. Full JSON only in trace store.
Eve: migration plan: phase 1 accept `decision_summary` field server-side and start emitting header in debug mode; phase 2 store full traces selectively and expose trace lookup API; phase 3 make header enabled by default after 2-week notice.
Marco: tests: header length fuzzing, compatibility tag matching unit tests, manifest->fallback integration test.
polly-bot: deploy queued: resolver-decision-summary -> staging. ETA 8m.
Eve: assigning owners: Marco -> schema + telemetry, Anya -> fallback algorithm + tests, me -> RFC write-up and console UX for trace lookup. If staging shows any regressions, drop logs into this thread.
